name: rapat-mobile
description: Hybrid iOS and Android app shell for RAPAT.my

scripts.mobile:init: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add android && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync && npm run mobile:configure
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync && npm run mobile:configure
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open ios
